config.label: Concur datacenter from your signed-in tab's host (e
config.description: Concur datacenter from your signed-in tab's host (e.g. us2, eu2). Defaults to us2.

config.label: fetchproxy bridge concentrator port
config.description: fetchproxy bridge concentrator port. Defaults to the fleet-shared 37149.

config.label: Where `concur_get_receipt` saves downloaded receipts (never overwriting an existing file)
config.description: Where `concur_get_receipt` saves downloaded receipts (never overwriting an existing file). Defaults to ~/Downloads/concur-mcp.

config.label: The only folders `concur_upload_receipt` will read from (a path-delimiter-separated list; `~` expanded)
config.description: The only folders `concur_upload_receipt` will read from (a path-delimiter-separated list; `~` expanded). Hosted (with `MCP_DATA_DIR` set) the default is `$MCP_DATA_DIR/uploads`. Defaults to ~/Downloads, ~/Documents and ~/Desktop, plus the working directory when it is a folder inside your home directory (never `/` or home itself).

config.label: `true` makes `concur_get_receipt` return the image in the result instead of writing a file
config.description: `true` makes `concur_get_receipt` return the image in the result instead of writing a file. Off locally, on when hosted.
